description: Sample of 'what the llm kernel takes', in the hooks style (id = key, input schema required); would live at $AOS_HOME/lib/tools/aos/kernel_llm/requests.json. The letter body has no kind field, so the id 'think' is a made-up name.

think.description: ask the brain once; the letter goes to <kernel stack>/requests

endpoint.description: pack name (see the endpoints of this kernel); left out = the kernel's default

reasoning_effort.description: a level the picked pack offers

request.description: an OpenAI chat completions body without the endpoint; stream is not done

priority.description: low, normal or high; a number; or {level, deadline}
